name: lean
description: Starter profile - a middle ground for a fresh Windows 11 Home install (edit to taste). PROVIDED AS IS, WITH NO WARRANTY: you run it at your own risk (see LICENSE). Turns off Copilot, Bing in search and Recall; removes Copilot, Power Automate, Phone Link, Widgets, the recommended Store apps, the Xbox app, To Do and Sticky Notes (removed for all users; their local data is deleted); Store suppression, privacy hardening, DiagTrack off, Balanced permissions, component store cleanup. Dry run first: WHD.ps1 -Apply profiles\lean.json, then add -Execute.
